about: desk space to arm space: arm [x, y, z, 1] = desk_to_arm @ desk [x, y, z, 1]. Desk space is millimetres on the desk, z the height above its surface (0: the cup snug on it). This one is condor's three measured desk heights (the tilt) composed with dolphin's grid-paper x/y correction (the arm's x travels ~7% short); the tilt calibration replaces it.
